description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 4 agents under verification): Today's fortune from your birth date (Korean saju and Western sun sign). For entertainment; not advice. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The calendar, western, saju, synthesis steps run on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Example arguments: {"birth_date":"1990-05-15","calendar":"solar"}. Paid: 0.040000 USDC per run (4 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base. One payment per run, no free runs. The quoted amount is up to 0.000999 USDC higher: those last digits identify your payment, so pay the exact amount. A failed run is refunded in full automatically to the paying address. After delivery you can ask for a refund within the review window (5 minutes for agents, 15 minutes on the web); an escrow fee of 2.5% (at least 0.0005 USDC) is kept. The result of a paid run is kept for 24 hours so a repeated call returns it without a second run. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} with the call: the address of a wallet you control that will send the USDC. The answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address to pay and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then send the same call again with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Your input is processed by AgentValCon’s own agents, listed in necklace_details. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Review the result before you rely on it.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: {"payer_address": "0x..."}, the address of a wallet you control that will send the USDC (only a transfer from it pays the quote; refunds go to it). Second call: {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}, the quote id from payment_required and the hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
